title: AutoSFT: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22194v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language model agents increasingly automate post-training, but when given the full training stack they converge on supervised fine-tuning and spend most effort revising training data. Existing systems give the agent one kind of control, selecting rows from a fixed pool or calling a generator, whereas a human data engineer adjusts proportions, prunes, repairs, replaces and synthesizes the data. We design a data action space for these changes and ask whether an automated system can make the full range rather than one of them, and what structure that requires. We first run this loop with a single agent, and it reaches only one action, adjusting category proportions, while its context fills with execution output and is discarded mid-search. translated_title: AutoSFT：一个用于监督微调中自动化数据研究的智能体系统
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体日益推动后训练的自动化，但当被赋予完整的训练流程时，它们会收敛到监督微调，并将大部分精力用于修改训练数据。现有系统只赋予智能体一种控制方式——从固定数据池中选取样本或调用生成器——而人类数据工程师则会调整数据比例、删减、修复、替换和合成数据。我们为这些操作设计了一个数据动作空间，并探究自动化系统能否执行全部操作而非仅其中一种，以及这需要什么样的系统结构。我们首先用单个智能体运行这一循环，结果它只执行了一种动作——调整类别比例，同时其上下文被执行输出填满并在搜索中途被丢弃。因此，我们提出了AutoSFT，一个多智能体系统，其中元智能体将执行与分析分离，从多个独立角度收集建议，并调用综合子智能体来提升能力。
tldr: 提出AutoSFT——一个多智能体系统，通过元智能体将执行与分析分离、从独立视角收集建议并调用综合子智能体，使自动化系统能够执行人类数据工程师的完整数据操作空间（调整比例、删减、修复、替换与合成），突破了现有系统单一数据控制方式的局限。
en_tdlr: AutoSFT, a multi-agent system where a meta agent separates execution from analysis, gathers proposals from independent angles, and calls a synthesis subagent, enabling automated systems to perform the full range of data engineering actions (adjusting proportions, pruning, repairing, replacing, and synthesizing) rather than a single control type in supervised fine-tuning.
